listing.name: Banjo-Kazooie / Banjo: Recompiled [Android Port] (AurelioB)
listing.summary: Explore Banjo-Kazooie / Banjo: Recompiled [Android Port] (AurelioB) and follow the upstream project for requirements, downloads and setup.

steps.title: Finish setup in the upstream Android app
steps.instruction: Install the Android ARM64 APK from this fork’s selected release, then open the app and choose your own North American 1.0 Banjo-Kazooie ROM when asked. The app handles its supported ROM import; there is no PC extraction/build step for the player. Desktop Banjo releases and another fork’s setup are separate choices.

steps.title: Keep your data when changing versions
steps.instruction: Saves, configuration, imported ROM, mods, texture packs and caches use app-private storage under com.aure.banjorecomp. Preserve that data before uninstalling or clearing app data. Follow the upstream Android update process so the installed app identity/signature can be retained. Portcove does not back up this Android profile or manage APK replacement.
